notes_for_editor: The 1934 build and 1941 abandonment agree in the register and on firelookout.com, so the record dates stand. The record's location conflict is real: the register point (45.485006, -121.526563) and the firelookout.org point (45.50509, -121.52508) are about 2.2 km apart (record distance_m 2236). The Oregon Hikers Rim Rock point (45.48863, -121.52329) sits near the register point. The register point is also close to the Rimrock South record (us-or-rimrock-south; firelookout.org point 45.48849, -121.52292), so Rimrock North and Rimrock South may describe one ridge-top site on Surveyor's Ridge. Check this before publishing either story. A 2007 Trail Advocates forum post ('The Other Rim Rock', Tom Kloster, http://www.trailadvocate.org/discuss/msgReader$631?mode=topic) places a lookout on a rim north of Shellrock Mountain and questions whether two Rim Rock lookouts existed. It is not cited in the story. Apart from the register and firelookout.com, no source I found uses the name Rimrock North. The hike and foundation-block details describe the Oregon Hikers Rim Rock site and are not confirmed as this entry. Access is left unset (record says unknown). The register photo (Ron Kemnow) is already in the record and is not a new find.
